definitions.explanation: The difference in time between two time zones.
A gap or delay in time between events or processes.

examples.japanese: {日本|にほん}とニューヨークの{時差|じさ}は14{時間|じかん}です。
examples.english: The time difference between Japan and New York is 14 hours.

examples.japanese: {時差|じさ}{出勤|しゅっきん}を{導入|どうにゅう}する{会社|かいしゃ}が{増|ふ}えている。
examples.english: More companies are introducing staggered work hours.

notes:
{時差|じさ} combines {時|じ} (time) + {差|さ} (difference).

COMMON COMPOUNDS:
- {時差|じさ}ボケ (jet lag)
- {時差|じさ}{出勤|しゅっきん} (staggered commuting)
- {時差|じさ}{通勤|つうきん} (staggered commuting)

COMMON PATTERNS:
- ～との{時差|じさ} (time difference with ~)
- {時差|じさ}が～{時間|じかん} (time difference of ~ hours)
- {時差|じさ}を{計算|けいさん}する (to calculate time difference)

USAGE NOTES:
- Essential for international communication and travel
- {時差|じさ}ボケ (jet lag) is one of the most common uses
